description: BlueSky: act on a post or actor. Post: like/unlike, repost/unrepost, delete (your own). Actor: follow/unfollow, mute/unmute, block/unblock. Undo actions resolve the record key automatically — never pass rkeys.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session (the bsky.app tab). Auto-resolved if omitted.

target.description: Post actions (like/unlike/repost/unrepost/delete): post AT-URI or bsky.app URL. Actor actions (follow/unfollow/mute/unmute/block/unblock): handle or DID.

name: bluesky_action
